title: ReBorn shared definitions
description: Identifiers, statuses and evidence references reused by every ReBorn contract.

status.description: confirmed = an observation of the running program, or two different kinds of proof (runtime, shipped-data, static-code, documentation; two static readings of one binary count once), or an entity built from a shipped SQL script. Enforced by validate. partial = some aspects proven; hypothesis = plausible, not proven; refuted = contradicted by evidence.

priority.description: Rebuild priority: must = needed for the demo / MVP.

ref.description: An id that exists: an evidence id from evidence/index.yaml (ev_<64 hex>, rb_..., sql:..., ui:..., doc:...) for kinds rea, craft and manual; a run id (run-...) for h-run; an observation id (O-...); or a screenshot path. A reference that does not resolve is a validation error.

locator.description: Where inside the evidence: run step, file:lines, address, module node_id, table name.
